data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic roots ‘asha’ (noble) and ‘eena’ (honored), Asheeyana is a name of great significance and prestige in Islamic culture. This name signifies a person of noble character and high esteem. It is also believed to be a spiritual name, evoking feelings of peace, purity, and reverence. The name Asheeyana carries the meaning “Noble, Honored” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Asheeyana usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, honored and live with faith, good character and purpose.
